summary: Welcome Footer 4-style responsive contract verification - PARTIAL PASS. 4/5 viewport tests passed. Critical issue found at 875px width where footer link columns show 3+1 layout instead of expected 2x2 layout.

ui_bugs.issue: At 875px width (compact tablet band 560-879px), footer link columns display 3+1 layout (PRODUCT, RESOURCES, COMPANY on row 1; LEGAL alone on row 2) instead of expected 2x2 layout (2 columns per row)
ui_bugs.root_cause: The useCompactTabletFooter styles (lines 1390-1398) set flexBasis to compactTabletLinkColumnWidth (370px), but the actual computed style shows flex-basis: 42% which comes from the fallback condition (isTabletBand && !useTabletFourColumnFooter && !useCompactTabletFooter). This suggests the useCompactTabletFooter condition is not being applied correctly or is being overridden.
ui_bugs.expected_behavior: 2x2 layout with PRODUCT+RESOURCES on row 1, COMPANY+LEGAL on row 2
ui_bugs.actual_behavior: 3+1 layout with PRODUCT+RESOURCES+COMPANY on row 1, LEGAL alone on row 2

issues: LEGAL column isolated on its own row creates visual imbalance and empty space

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 4-style responsive contract is mostly working but has a critical issue at 875px.
